title.value: Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellows Program
title.evidence_quote: This year marks the final application cycle for the Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellows Program at the University of Michigan.

institution.name: Michigan Institute for Data and AI in Society (MIDAS), University of Michigan

field: AI in the natural sciences, engineering and mathematics
qualifications: PhD in any field, conferred before the fellowship start (August or September 2027) and received after 1 September 2022
Two U-M faculty mentors for the full 2 years: one AI mentor and one science mentor; a prior or current faculty mentor is ineligible
Biomedical proposals focused on disease diagnosis, prevention or treatment are out of scope
Fellows must work in person on the University of Michigan campus
Materials: CV, AI keywords, research tagline and blurb, research statement, Individualized Development Plan, Responsible AI statement, letters from both mentors
description_short: Two-year postdoctoral fellowship at the University of Michigan applying AI in the sciences, engineering and mathematics, with one AI mentor and one science mentor. This is the final application cycle; the priority deadline is 23 November 2026, with starts in August or September 2027.

deadline.evidence_quote: priority deadline of 11:59 pm EST, Nov. 23, 2026, and all applications received by this deadline will be given full consideration

status_evidence: Official MIDAS application page (search results): priority deadline 23 November 2026 for the 2027 cohort
Offers start to be sent in February 2027
